question.q: How do I handle an angry customer?

title.th: วิธี LAST ในการจัดการข้อร้องเรียน

response.text:
From "The LAST method for complaints" [S1]:
LAST is a four-step way to handle a complaint. Listen: let the customer finish without interrupting, and repeat the main point back. Apologise: say sorry for the experience, even if it was not your fault. Solve: offer a fix within your authority, such as an exchange or refund under the returns policy, or call a supervisor if it is beyond it.

question.q: What does OEE mean?

title.th: อธิบาย OEE ด้วยไลน์ผลิตเดียว

response.text:
From "OEE explained with one line" [S1]:
OEE = Availability x Performance x Quality. Availability is run time divided by planned time; stops and changeovers reduce it. Performance is actual speed against ideal speed; small stops and slow running reduce it. Quality is good units divided by total units; scrap and rework reduce it. Example: 90% availability x 85% performance x 98% quality = 75% OEE.
